messages:
Maya (Product): Quick sync — I sketched a lightweight Gantt for the Q3 inference roadmap to spot critical gates. Need owners + hard blockers by EOD. This is about Dedicated + Private launch sequencing.
Ethan (Eng-Platform): sending over dependency matrix now. main concerns: routing policy rollout and console telemetry gating.
Riya (Eng-Runtime): Runtime needs kernel stability (quantized kernels) before we can certify the Dedicated images. ETA risk: ~3 weeks if infra scheduling lands.
Carlos (Eng-Infra): infra can reserve GPUs for Dedicated, but we need the final node spec by Friday. if not, capacity allocation slips.
Lena (Eng-SRE): we need an SLO cutover plan for traffic shift — can do canary but need fallback routes mapped. Who owns the fallback policy? @Ethan?
Ethan (Eng-Platform): I can own fallback routing. need a list of compatible model variants and regions. @Riya can you provide mapping of variant compatibility?
Riya (Eng-Runtime): yes — attaching quick mapping in CSV. fields: model_variant, quant_profile, compatible_regions. will push to the repo after this thread.
Noah (Design): UI ask: Console rollout needs a small UX for pinning model versions + rollout controls. estimate 2 sprints. Can product prioritize which fields are MVP?
Maya (Product): MVP: pin version, canary toggle, and percentage control. postpone per-model telemetry until later.
Priya (Customer Success): top customers (FinCorp & HealthPlus) asked for guaranteed private-region deployment and audit logs. That drives Private launch gating.
Alex (Sales): both have signed LOIs pending our Private SLA. any delay here pushes renewals. prioritization note: Private > Dedicated for those accounts.
Carlos (Eng-Infra): to satisfy Private SLA we need KMS integration + network policy checks. KMS is a blocker unless security approves ephemeral keys.
Lena (Eng-SRE): also need log retention config for audit trails. Ops: add retention policy to infra checklist.
Maya (Product): OK — proposed critical path: 1) Kernel/quant stability (Riya) 2) Node spec + capacity reservation (Carlos) 3) Canary routing + fallback (Ethan/Lena) 4) Console MVP (Noah) 5) KMS + audit (Carlos/Lena). Anyone disagree?
Ethan (Eng-Platform): sounds right. can we add a parallel path to start console wireframes now — reduces sequencing risk.
Noah (Design): will start wireframes today. need API contracts for rollout toggles — @Ethan can you dump the API shape?
Ethan (Eng-Platform): sure. brief shape: 
```
POST /api/rollouts
{ "model": "string", "version": "string", "canary_percent": 10 }
```
I'll open a PR.
Riya (Eng-Runtime): blocker note: quant kernels depend on the new mem-management patch in runtime repo. patch review is in progress (PR #482). if review stalls, move to plan B: pin older kernel and accept higher cost.
Maya (Product): put PR #482 as a gating item in the tracker. if not merged in 5 business days, we trigger plan B.
Priya (Customer Success): can we communicate these gating criteria to FinCorp & HealthPlus by EOD tomorrow? I'll draft a note.
Alex (Sales): please cc me. I’ll sync with their procurement team.
Carlos (Eng-Infra): action: finalize node spec by Fri. action: start KMS questionnaire with security — assigned to me.
Lena (Eng-SRE): action: canary runbook and rollback steps — I'll draft and post in #eng-oncall tomorrow.
Maya (Product): I'll update the centralized dependency board with these gates. quick ask: everyone drop single-line blocker updates here when status changes.
deploy-bot: build/runtime-tests CI passed for PR #482 (link: https://ci.internal/482) :white_check_mark:
Ethan (Eng-Platform): thanks — if CI stays green we may hit the optimistic timeline.
Maya (Product): great. planning note: if anything slips, we re-sequence Console after Dedicated core launch. will convene a follow-up tomorrow 11am.
Noah (Design): ack — sharing preliminary mocks before 11am.
Riya (Eng-Runtime): ack — I'll post kernel stability metrics by 10am.
Carlos (Eng-Infra): ack on KMS questionnaire start.
Maya (Product): thanks everyone. short, frequent updates please — this thread will be the canonical tracker until I move items into the roadmap board. :thumbsup:
